request.what: Cardano at TOKEN2049 Singapore 2026: Top-Up ‘Title’ Sponsorship Upgrade
deliverables: Modular top-up unlocks the ‘ Title’ Sponsorship tier, the highest level of visibility at TOKEN2049.

This is an incremental request of 1,768,167 ada (equivalent to $424,360 USD, calculated at an estimated rate of $0.24 per ada) to upgrade Cardano’s presence from a 108 sqm booth to a massive 144 sqm footprint and secure a Mainstage Keynote.

Dependency Notice: This is a top-up proposal intended to be voted on in conjunction with the Cardano at TOKEN2049 Singapore 2026: Baseline ‘Platinum’ Sponsorship proposal (Gov Action ID: gov action18u8lpkzge2csxe3plynn9lh4agwtv3nrqkyfwalwj4ykjv7l68jqqzmul9z).

If this proposal is ratified without the approval of the ‘Platinum’ Sponsorship proposal, EMURGO commits to returning 100% of the funds to the Cardano Treasury within 30 days of enactment, as there would be no underlying sponsorship to upgrade.

The core motivation of this proposal is to provide Cardano builders with a professional, high-traffic platform to demonstrate their innovations.
